title: Grumman AA-5B Tiger — Normal Operating Procedures
description: Normal operating procedures for the Grumman AA-5B Tiger with Lycoming O-360 carbureted engine. Covers preflight walk-around through shutdown and securing. Reflects the Tiger’s distinctive features: sliding canopy, low wing, LEFT/RIGHT/BOTH fuel selector, and stabilator tail. Contains no numeric limitations; all airspeeds, fuel quantities, power settings, and performance values must be obtained from the specific aircraft POH.

source.notes: No manufacturer document consulted. Written from general familiarity with the Grumman AA-5B Tiger and Lycoming O-360 carbureted engine systems.

known_issues.description: Contains no airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities or other limitations — must come from aircraft POH.
Equipment variations exist across AA-5B production. Avionics, fuel capacity, and optional equipment differ by aircraft. Verify all items against the specific aircraft POH before use.

rights.notes: Grumman/American General POH remains under copyright. This file is independently authored and does not reproduce the wording or item selection of any manufacturer document.
